source_title: Disruptive Announces $10 billion Flagship Fund - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
One of a small number of technology-focused investment funds of this size
The firm plans to invest in approximately 10 exceptional growth and late-stage companies, investing up to $1 billion per company
DALLAS , Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Disruptive today announced the Disruptive Flagship Fund, a $10 billion fund designed to scale the firm's selective approach to backing category-leading private technology companies.
The Disruptive Flagship Fund is one of a small number of private technology-focused investment funds of its size. Disruptive's long-standing LP relationships and distinct capital base enabled the firm to secure capital commitments and respond to growing demand from its LPs for consistent access to the firm's investments.
The Disruptive Flagship Fund comes at a defining moment for technology investing. Advances in artificial intelligence, the massive buildout of compute infrastructure, and a new era of investment in defense and national security are creating companies of unprecedented scale and strategic importance. The amount of capital required to capture these opportunities is increasing significantly.
Disruptive was built for this moment. Since its founding in 2012, the firm has developed an investment model designed to identify a small number of exceptional companies and deploy significant capital behind them. Disruptive also works closely with founders through critical stages of growth, bringing capital, networks, hands-on support and strategy.
Disruptive's investment approach remains unchanged and the firm plans to back approximately 10 exceptional growth and late-stage companies, investing up to $1 billion per company.
Alex Davis, Founder and CEO of Disruptive, commented: "The best private technology companies are growing larger, staying private longer and requiring more capital than ever before. We have always focused on a small number of exceptional companies, building the conviction and relationships to be there for founders at their most important moments. The Disruptive Flagship Fund gives us the scale to match the opportunity."
Disruptive Technology Advisers LLC or "Disruptive" is a global investment firm focused on backing category-leading private technology companies.
Founded in 2012 by Alex Davis, Disruptive invests significant capital behind a select number of high-conviction opportunities across artificial intelligence, AI infrastructure, defense technology, enterprise software and other sectors shaping the future of technology.
Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, the firm invests through primary, secondary and structured transactions, partnering closely with founders and management teams through critical stages of growth, scale and liquidity. The firm's portfolio past and present includes companies such as Airbnb, Databricks, ElevenLabs, Helsing, Groq, Palantir, Reflection AI, Spotify and Shield AI, to name a few.
This list of companies mentioned in "About Disruptive" is not representative of all investments.
Interests in the Fund are being offered only to persons who are accredited investors, and the Fund will take reasonable steps to verify accredited investor status. This announcement is for informational purposes only and does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities, which will be made only by means of the Fund's confidential offering documents.
